title: Crypto.fips is deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates crypto.fips (DEP0093: documentation-only since v10.0.0, runtime deprecation since v23.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of crypto.fips with crypto.setFips() and crypto.getFips().

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
